name: Work day
description: Calendar + email + WhatsApp + an LLM-synthesised top-of-day briefing
author: yorik-core

synthesize.prompt: Compose a tight 2-paragraph morning briefing in the user's language. First paragraph: the 3 most important things to act on today (across email, WhatsApp, calendar). Second paragraph: anything else worth being aware of. Don't repeat the section labels. Don't pad.
